title: Mangrove Drop
description: A growly detuned Reese bass that breathes and menaces beneath tropical sunshine — two sawtooth layers widen into a seething low-end wall, while mutually-prime LFOs on detune, filter cutoff, resonance, FM index, and tremolo depth ensure the wub never realigns, travelling from a lean verse growl through a grit-heavy drop to a tremolo-gated ratchet finish.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c1>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(19).range(0.08, 0.38))
    .fm(sine.slow(11).range(0.5, 6)).fmh("<1 1.5 0.5 2>/8")
    .off(0.006, x => x.add(note(0.22)).gain(0.45).pan(sine.slow(23).range(0.25, 0.75)))
    .lpf(sine.slow(17).range(180, 1800)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(4, 14)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<2 4 3 6>/16").lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.18)
    .tremolosync("<4 8 4 16>/11").tremolodepth(sine.slow(29).range(0.1, 0.72))
    .shape(sine.slow(23).range(0.15, 0.55))
    .crush("<16 12 8 6>/16")
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.14).sustain(0.65).release(0.08)
    .ply("<1 1 2 1>/16")
    .sometimesBy(0.1, x => x.speed(-1))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .room(0.12).delay("0.3:0.19:0.45")
    .postgain(1.05).gain(0.9)
)
